sources.title: Qwen3.5 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Download the model via (after installing pip install huggingface_hub hf_transfer ). You can choose MXFP4_MOE (dynamic 4bit) or other quantized versions like UD-Q4_K_XL . We recommend using at least 2-bit dynamic quant UD-Q2_K_XL to balance size ...

sources.title: Qwen3 - How to Run & Fine-tune | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: from unsloth import FastModel import torch model, tokenizer = FastModel.from_pretrained( model_name = "unsloth/Qwen3-30B-A3B", max_seq_length = 2048, # Choose any for long context! load_in_4bit = True, # 4 bit quantization to reduce memory load_in_8bit = False, # [NEW!] A bit more accurate, uses 2x memory full_finetuning = False, # [NEW!] We have full finetuning now!
